title: Potions and Stuff
description: Remake of Potions & such by magnusMakesGames for Forge 1.20.1
body:
This is an remake of the mod https://modrinth.com/mod/potions-and-such
I remade this mod from the ground up for Forge 1.20.1 without copying any of the original code. The purpose of this remake is to avoid using a connector in all my modpacks just for one mod.

Features similar to the original mod:

Potions now form stacks of 3

![Potions stacking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e111ef786a2d57e920bde0c6b065f122eaad23f2.png)

The Fletching Table now works, and it allows you to make dipped arrows, explosive arrows and spectral arrows (and combinations of those three). (the GUI design is from the original mod)

![Fletching table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5ea569d30f9e6211fb0b16b15b51982efbecd8f.png)

4 potion effects:
- Recall: Teleports you to your spawnpoint when the effect runs out
- Heartache: Halts natural regeneration
- Attraction: Nearby entities are pulled towards the entity with the effect
- Repulsion: Nearby entities are pushed away from the entity with the effect


New, original features:
5 other potion effects:
- Entropy (this one is different from the original mod): increases xp gain / increases xp dropped by any entity with the effect. Brewed with echo shards.
- Transmutation: morphs most mobs into harmless creatures. Brewed with Command blocks.
- Wither: same effect as the vanilla "Wither". Brewed with Wither roses.
- Vampirism: recover health when you attack. Brewed with suspicious stew.
- Thorns: damages the attacker. Brewed with cacti.
    

New mob: Dabbler
It spawns in caves (under y32), is quite rare and sometimes throws helpful lingering potions at players. Gets angry if hit, and can drop a "Potion bundle" if you kill it. You can also barter with it using nether wart.
